purpose: Verify OA-BR-61 fails closed when programme is unspecified or null.

expected_result: allowed=False with clear explanatory reason indicating postgraduate standing required.

purpose: Verify OA-BR-62 mandates automatic creation of an audit log entry when a seminar is scheduled.
preconditions: A request in AWAITING_SCHEDULING exists. Department Administrator schedules the seminar.
action_or_input: Schedule request via service or API.
expected_result: SeminarSchedulingHistory record is created containing action='SCHEDULED', valid recorded_by_id, and details.

purpose: Verify OA-BR-62 history log is linked to the GraduateSeminar and persists all scheduling actions.
preconditions: Seminar is scheduled and history log is recorded.
expected_result: history_logs queryset contains the audit record referencing the exact seminar instance.

purpose: Verify OA-BR-51 ensures a TA allocation must link to a course, a faculty member, or both.
action_or_input: Submit TA allocation with valid course_code and/or faculty_id.
expected_result: TA allocation record successfully validates and persists.

purpose: Verify OA-BR-63 ensures public calendar displays only seminars in SCHEDULED status.
preconditions: Requests exist across statuses: AWAITING_SCHEDULING, SCHEDULED, REJECTED, CANCELLED.
expected_result: Only the SCHEDULED seminar appears; pending, rejected, and cancelled requests are not exposed.
